lastResponse.text: You’re doing the right thing calling, and I can go slow. For diapers today, try Lane County Diaper Bank: 3050 Game Farm Road, Springfield. You can call 5-4-1 … 2-2-1 … 0-8-2-4. They provide diapers and wipes, Monday through Friday, 8 to 5. If you have OHP, WIC, or SNAP, you should qualify, and no documents are needed at intake.
